legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.s1_body: ObatLog (the "Service") is a web application for managing personal medication records. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical care.
legal.terms.s2_body:
• The Service does not provide medical advice. Always consult a doctor or pharmacist for health decisions.
• You use the Service at your own risk.
• Overdose checks are for reference only; accuracy is not guaranteed.
• The operator is not liable for any damage arising from use of the Service.
legal.terms.s3_body:
The following is prohibited:
• Unauthorized access or attacks on the Service
• Misuse of other users' accounts
• Interference with operation of the Service
• Any activity that violates applicable law
legal.terms.s4_body: The operator may change or discontinue the Service without prior notice and is not liable for damage caused by such changes or discontinuation.
legal.terms.s5_body: These terms are governed by the laws of Japan.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s1_body:
To provide the Service, we collect:
• Email address (for sign-in)
• Medication records (name, dose, time)
• Notification tokens (for reminder notifications)
legal.privacy.s2_body:
We use collected information only to:
• Provide recording and management features
• Perform daily overdose prevention checks
• Send reminder notifications
legal.privacy.s3_body:
We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for their marketing.

The Service uses Google Firebase as infrastructure. Data is handled under Firebase security and privacy practices. See https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
legal.privacy.s4_body: You can delete your account to remove related data (records, medications, notification settings). Deleted data cannot be recovered.
legal.privacy.s5_body: We use cookies for Firebase Authentication session management. We do not use cookies for advertising.
legal.privacy.s6_body: For privacy inquiries, contact the operator (Osaka29 Tech Bureau, osaka29.jp) or contract@osaka29.jp.
